description: This file provides shared support for tests using Testcontainers with PostgreSQL in a Spring Boot environment. It manages starting a PostgreSQL container once per JVM and dynamically registering data source properties for integration tests.

classes.name: PostgresTestContainerSupport
classes.description: Abstract class providing PostgreSQL Testcontainer setup and configuration for testing environments.

methods.name: registerPgProperties
methods.description: Registers PostgreSQL datasource properties with Spring Boot's DynamicPropertyRegistry for use in tests.
